While xanthinuria management focuses on dietary modifications and hydration to prevent xanthine crystalluria, Lesch-Nyhan syndrome treatment is largely symptomatic. However, insights into purine metabolism may reveal novel targets for managing the downstream consequences of both conditions, potentially including neurological aspects or metabolic complications.
